clips.title: The story
paras: At Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar watches for threats within Durotar. He gathers intelligence and coordinates defenses against dangers to the young orc nation, especially the Burning Blade cult in the canyons.

At Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar tracks hidden threats across Durotar. While grunt patrols watch for Alliance forces and centaur raiders, he looks for danger among the orcs themselves. Scouts bring him reports from across the region, and he searches them for signs of corrupt rituals and secret gatherings.
